brief:
Humanitarian agencies have distributed food and essential supplies to hundreds of thousands of people across Gaza as the territory faces severe food insecurity, according to UN News. The deliveries continue despite mounting challenges in reaching populations in need throughout the enclave.

Hunger has intensified across Gaza in recent weeks, prompting sustained aid operations by international organizations working to address critical shortages. Agencies report that families throughout the territory lack adequate access to basic foodstuffs and other necessities. The ongoing delivery efforts represent a central focus of humanitarian work in the region as conditions deteriorate.
dek: As hunger deepens across Gaza, humanitarian agencies continue to deliver food and other essential supplies to families in need.
title: UN delivers aid to hundreds of thousands facing Gaza hunger crisis
